text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NASA-047","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N15","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N15 requires penetrant (DP) and ultrasonic (UT) testing after heat treatment but before the finish machining of the component, yet no separate note explicitly instructs that this inspection must occur before finish machining. Without a clear hold-point note, the machinist may complete all machining before NDT, preventing detection of subsurface defects introduced by heat treatment. Add a note stating that DP and UT inspection shall be performed prior to finish machining.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'PERFORM DP AND UT INSPECTION AFTER HEAT TREATMENT AND BEFORE FINISH MACHINING' to establish the required inspection sequence."}]}
